catastrophe_history: Tick 109030 — Endured The Great Hack (Digital Era). 101 buildings lost.

lines: Its message arrived as geometry, and the linguists needed a day to make it into words.

In the great dark past the last charted star, something that had been patient for longer than there have been stars had finally turned its attention toward the colony, and the estimate on every screen was simply the colony's way of saying so.
